items.title: File Widerspruch against partial refusal of plastic-frame windows
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Hansestadt Beispielwismar, Am Markt 1, 23966 Beispielwismar.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by the authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V (as the letter itself states), it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting = Mon 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after that (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) = Tue 24.11.2026, and ends one month later, on the day with the same number, Wed 23.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in MV, so no weekend/holiday shift applies.

warnings: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern keeps an older 3-day deemed-delivery rule (§ 120a VwVfG M-V) for matters already pending before 1 January 2025 that are decided under the Land's own procedure law; if this permit application was filed before that date, delivery would instead be deemed on Sun 22.11.2026 and the Widerspruch deadline would be Tue 22.12.2026 — one day earlier than computed above. Check which rule applies or send the Widerspruch a few days early to be safe.

The letter mentions a Zuschuss (grant) for wood-frame windows 'auf Antrag' but gives no application deadline or amount, so no item could be created for it; ask the Denkmalschutzbehörde directly if you want to apply.
